invariants.rationale: instantTime is a required String argument and should never be null.
HoodieEngineContext context should not be null when scheduling compaction.
Option typically should not be null, as Option type should represent 'no value' via Option.empty() instead.
instantTime should be a non-empty String for scheduling-related methods.
Option.isPresent() is always a safe check and does not throw, and this is safe to evaluate.
